_comment: Output of the CRM ingestion call (one constrained-JSON call per note). Cached so the demo runs without API latency. Regenerate with `python ingest.py --crm`.

objection_contexts.Outcomes: Two affiliated practices test below the network average; asked for before/after adoption data from comparable health systems.

P01.entire_note_context: CMO tracking network-wide testing adoption as a value-based contract quality metric. Wants comparative adoption evidence.

objection_contexts.Incumbent: Satisfied with FoundationOne at 10-12 days and not shopping vendors; open to a blood-based option only where repeat biopsy is risky.

P02.entire_note_context: Happy with current vendor and workflow. Narrow opening around patients where re-biopsy carries risk. Wants comparative data before any change.

objection_contexts.Referral: An external genetics referral adds three to four weeks before a PARP-inhibitor decision can be finalised.

P03.entire_note_context: Breast/gyn oncologist losing weeks to outside genetics referrals before PARP decisions. Asked directly whether HRD can attach to an existing order without a new biopsy.

objection_contexts.Turnaround: A Guardant360 order took 21 days and the patient had already started empiric second-line chemo before results returned.

P04.entire_note_context: GI oncologist frustrated by a 21-day competitor turnaround that arrived after treatment had started. Asked for a specific day-count.

objection_contexts.Cost: The finance committee will want patient cost addressed before any new vendor is approved.

P05.entire_note_context: Community hospital haematologist on a narrow in-house PCR panel. Open to broader testing but gated on a finance committee.

objection_contexts.Outcomes: Wants evidence tied to survival or response, not gene counts, before recommending a vendor change to oncology staff.

P06.entire_note_context: CMO who needs board-facing outcomes evidence. Asked whether real-world immunotherapy outcomes data is available at network level.

objection_contexts.Actionability: Said there isn't much actionable in pancreatic anyway; unaware RNA subtyping can inform first-line regimen choice.

P07.entire_note_context: Pancreatic oncologist ordering almost no molecular testing. Reads as a knowledge gap rather than a stated objection.

objection_contexts.Tissue: Burned by a quantity-not-sufficient result from a prior vendor after a multi-week wait; prostate biopsies often yield limited tissue.

P08.entire_note_context: GU oncologist wary of insufficient-tissue failures after a prior QNS result. No current comprehensive vendor.

objection_contexts.Incumbent: Says FoundationOne covers his broad-panel needs; main unmet interest is trial matching for rare mutations.

P09.entire_note_context: Sarcoma oncologist settled on an incumbent for broad panels. Interested in trial matching for unusual mutations where local options are thin.

objection_contexts.Turnaround: By the time send-out results come back she has usually already started empiric chemo, which defeats the purpose.

P10.entire_note_context: Community thoracic oncologist with no in-house testing, relying on inconsistent local send-out. Turnaround is her stated blocker to adopting comprehensive testing at all.
